turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." You asked for this meeting, Hale, so answer my question: who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.

Then I'm going straight to the principal's office from here. Procedure 4.2 says you contact me before any mark goes in, and nobody did. Either you tell me now who decided on that zero, or you can explain it to the principal tonight.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I'll do better than email, Hale; I'm walking there now. Put your reasons for that zero in writing to me by tonight, because the principal is going to ask for them too.
